name: NodeCraft
description: A self-hosted, distributed platform for managing multiplayer game servers across a fleet of Docker-powered workers. Its full-stack control panel brings together real-time consoles, file management, granular permissions, monitoring, and automated S3-compatible backups.

name: Pede Pizza
description: A responsive pizza-delivery platform where users can browse the menu, customise orders, and manage a live shopping cart. Built with vanilla JavaScript and a Node.js/Express REST API, it delivers a streamlined ordering experience across devices.

name: SmartWiki
description: A responsive content and commerce platform exploring smart-city innovation and connected-home technology. It combines articles and guides with product discovery, search, wishlists, and a streamlined shopping experience, built with JavaScript and Bootstrap.
